decisions.summary: research-claim / research-claims / STATUS=done; RELEASE=<owner> WHY= releases another owner's claim with the reason on the line
decisions.why: FR-001's three commands and the edge case 'the command can release one claim by name with a reason'.
FR-001: 'The owner is the session's clone name'.

decisions.summary: new lines keep the sheet's pipe shape; read/check/append under fcntl.flock
decisions.why: Edge case 'the claim is made under a lock'; spec D1 keeps the sheet where it is.

decisions.summary: a line names a question by any 4-digit number, or by an old page name followed by a RUN of 3-digit numbers (space, slash, comma/and, SECTION=), each mapped through moved-303.json
decisions.why: Edge case 'by the page and number the old record used'. Round 1's list-form gap is closed: questions_of maps every number of a run (test_an_old_line_naming_a_run_of_numbers..., 8/8 green 2026-10-10). Re-measured 2026-10-10 through the tool's own parse over the real sheet: 1,138 lines, 415 owner-question pairs (round 1's scratch parse found 300 page-form pairs; the rest are 4-digit numbers).

decisions.summary: a claim is live while it is its owner's latest line naming the question and that line carries no done/released/landed/complete/withdrawn after the owner
decisions.why: The spec's rule 'live unless a later line for the same owner and item says it is done', read over the whole line because old lines carry the word in the item or a sixth field (round 1's note). The settled-feature retirement on read is gone: live() reads only the lines.

decisions.summary: research_claims.py sweep WRITES one release line per live claim of a feature speckit-todo reads as closed, reason on the line; run at landing, re-runnable, never applied on read
decisions.why: It produces exactly the 'later line ... says it is done' the edge case names, with its reason written, through the FR-001 tool - the within-spec route round 1 named. Measured 2026-10-10 through the tool: 258 questions / 334 claims live on the real sheet before any sweep.

decisions.summary: one line per live claim touching the asked questions plus one summary line
decisions.why: FR-001 'a few lines whatever the sheet's size'; SC-001.

decisions.summary: refuse Read/Edit/Write on the sheet and a Bash command with the sheet's file name as an operand of a read/write command (cat, sed, redirect, make lines/append, ...); a mention passes
decisions.why: FR-002's write and read routes; matching invocations rather than mentions keeps the guard to what FR-002 names (22/22 green 2026-10-10).
FR-002 refuses the routes with no carve-out; round 1's NOT LEGITIMATE escape is removed (CLAIMS_FILE_OK tested as no escape).

decisions.summary: page-session-rules.md, CLAUDE.md large-file rule in the GM's terms, guard rows; make lines/append stay for other coordination files
decisions.why: FR-003, FR-004; FR-003 is scoped to the claims file.

decisions.summary: quote_verbatim asks a PDF's URL (headers only) instead of NOT-CHECKED by extension
decisions.why: Serves FR-006's fix for R2's PDF gap; READABLE needs the link answered.

decisions.summary: CachedPages: cache, then live, then the archive's text.txt when the live page is not FETCHED; not cached
decisions.why: Fixes R2's second gap (the cache never asks the archive) for quote-verbatim, source-pages and bundles.

decisions.summary: a passage on archived text counts only when VERBATIM; otherwise NOT-CHECKED for the agent
decisions.why: A correctness constraint; the archive can confirm a quotation but never sink one.

decisions.summary: quote-verbatim before/after on real PDF-citing questions; a verdict that loses ground is a bug; NOT-CHECKED -> UNFETCHABLE for an asked-and-refused PDF accepted as the truer residue
decisions.why: FR-006's test; SC-004. R2's table shows no lost VERBATIM/READABLE and no new NOT-ON-PAGE/NOT-READABLE; the 4 UNFETCHABLE are one maff.go.jp PDF answering 403, both verdicts residue.

decisions.summary: archive-first-hooks.sh refuses an actor's FIRST WebFetch of a URL whose archived text exists, naming the text and capture date; the same actor's second fetch passes
decisions.why: FR-006: R2 now accounts for the 26 held fetches outside the checking agents (10 page-cache source-pages, 2 covered by D4, 14 ad-hoc WebFetch) and this is the named fix with a test that fails on the gap (8/8 green; the stripped hook passes the fetch). Its reach to every actor's WebFetch is the measured gap itself (946 of 1,213 agent fetches were held) and the request's own purpose ('search our existing research findings prior to going out'); it narrows nothing, since the second fetch always reaches the live page READABLE needs. FR-005's third measure for agents is stated (0 of 207).
